title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Frosty Forest Berries 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Frosty Forest Berries Nic Salt e-liquid delivers a delicious mix of rich, juicy forest Berries, perfectly balanced with a cool and refreshing icy finish. The medley of berries is sweet and tart, complemented by a frosty exhale that leaves your palate refreshed. Designed with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are ideal for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod systems. The e-liquid provides smooth throat hits and fast-acting nicotine relief, making it perfect for vapers seeking a fruity, cool alternative to tobacco. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Frosty Forest Berries offers a well-balanced vape for all-day enjoyment. Pukka Juice are an award-winning UK vape brand renowned for their vibrant and original e-liquid flavours. The Pukka Juice 5000+ range brings intense, disposable vape-inspired flavours to a more versatile format for use with reusable vape devices. Discover other popular flavours in the collection like Black Razz Breeze, Polar Mint, and Blueberry Strawberry Burst.
